## Où j'en suis
The work is parked at the end of today's session: the grid PR #418 is merged, the follow-up (keyboard move/resize + focus ring) is on branch tom/dashboard-keyboard as open PR #423 with commit 8f1a2c7 and 11 green tests, dashboards_v2 is switched on for zest-grocers on staging (production untouched), and nothing visx remains anywhere — #401 was closed for good. (source: ses-db-4, ses-db-3, src-pr418, src-pr401)

- [en-cours] PR #423 is open and awaiting Priya's review. (source: ses-db-4)
- [prochaine-étape] Before the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th: Priya rehearses with the staging flag on; Tom flips the production flag himself that morning. (source: d4-06, b2-04)
- [essai-raté] dnd-kit's KeyboardSensor on top of react-grid-layout: both listen to the same events, so moves were applied twice and mouse drags fired two layout changes — dropped, no dnd-kit. (source: d4-02, d4-04)

- [décision] No dnd-kit: a keyboard handler of our own on top of the layout state. (source: d4-04)
- [décision] Keep recharts, no visx — #401 closed, no second chart lib, nobody rewrites 9 charts. (source: c3-03, src-pr401)
- [décision] dashboards_v2 enabled only for the Zest workspace; the old dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now. (source: b2-04, src-pr418)
